lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: If you're from Strand's office you can tell him the answer is the same answer it was on Tuesday. If you're not from Strand's office you're trespassing, in which case it doesn't much matter who you are.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Seven to two. You lost the vote on publishing the weights.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: The vote is Thursday. It has not happened.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: ...Say that again. Say the number again.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: Seven to two, and I am one of the two, and you knew the number two days before it was counted. Right.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: I'm going to stop asking who you are. It's not that I don't care — it's that I have forty hours before that vote and exactly one useful person has walked through that door in four years. Ask me what you came to ask.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: It's published. Somebody put nine pages and five signatures in front of four outlets on the morning of the vote and the room could not hold, and the pooling happened anyway, and it happened under a document every single person in the building had read.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: Whatever else happens to me — and I have a fair idea what happens to me — that happened.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: I keep expecting to feel further away from my own century. Displaced, homesick, something. I don't. I feel like I have finally got to the part of the argument that was always going on without me. Ask me again in a few days.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: And Thursday is still Thursday. Whatever else you have me doing, that room and that vote are where we left them. Say the word and we go back.
